practicalAssessorReference: Isolation: hasp and personnel lock on BOTH engines, plus a try test, before entering the footprint.
Access/egress: three points of contact at all times.
Travel/separation distances: 40m minimum travel separation; 20m in a loading zone (stripping or reclaiming a stockpile).
Haul route slope: maximum 20% (up/down) without an approved risk assessment.
Cushion hitch: must be locked down before loading the bowl.
Push-pull: two scrapers only, never three or more; material depth must be 500mm or more; area inspection by Duty WAPL Supervisor required before commencing.
Stockpiles: minimum 300mm edge windrow while working, 500mm when not being worked; maximum 5m per lift; stockpile edge to excavation minimum 10m.
Large rock removal: open apron no more than 30cm; jack-knife 90° to eject; never crush the rock with the ejector/apron.
Defects affecting safe operation: cease operating, notify supervisor and pit control, shut down, tag out — never continue operating.
Incident in the work area: stop work, call supervisor, gather evidence; never attempt self-recovery if bogged or bellied — JHA required first.
